goal: Create .agents/agents/pmcro-chief-<role>.md for all 12 Chief personas, composing their existing skill and governance contract by reference, with a shared permission-derived tools allowlist and a per-domain Economic Rationale.
success_criteria: 12 new files exist, one per Chief id already registered in .pmcro/directory/agents.yaml (kind: persona)
Each frontmatter description is drawn verbatim from that Chief's existing agents.yaml description - not paraphrased or invented
None duplicate the reasoning-mode trigger table (that stays owned by plugins/pmcro-csuite/omode/<code>.yaml) - each file points to it by path instead

Each has an Economic Rationale grounded in the real mechanism these Chiefs implement (an upfront reasoning-strategy/scope selection before Planner handoff), not an invented figure
No placeholder tokens or absolute/drive-letter paths (same automated check as the lifecycle-role trail)
Committed together with a message referencing this trail
